rule: Apply 0.42 EUR/kWh only to Zunder Spain EVSEs proven to be standard AC charging at <=50 kW, and 0.59 EUR/kWh only to Zunder Spain EVSEs proven to be standard fast charging >50 kW. Any EVSE identified as a time-band tariff, municipal agreement, partner agreement, specific-location exception, or whose tariff class cannot be positively established remains fail-closed/unpriced until an exact station tariff is obtained. Never use the published ranges or 'from' prices as an exact tariff.
